ranking_rationale: All three buckets here are negative or near-zero, so 'revenue growth is decelerating' cannot by itself distinguish 'below' from 'within'; the top traces recognised this and either kept mass broad (hgf) or argued explicitly for a moderate rather than extreme deceleration (factor_memory, structured_reasoning). The bottom traces asserted the same directional headlines, invented a precise pp interval their own magnitude fields called insufficient, and then concentrated 0.6-0.75 of the mass on the boundary crossing they had just declared unverifiable, with principle_memory filing an option its own narrative argued against and case_memory contradicting its own support label.
shared_evidence_note: The E1 traces did see segment-level items absent from E0 (AWS up 19% in Q4, advertising 'still speeding up', 'cloud growth comes up short'), which let them post genuine up-drivers against the weak guidance, but the decisive split was reasoning rather than evidence: within E0 alone the same four headlines produced both 'below recent range' at 0.75 and 'within recent range' at 0.5.
